title: Spatial averaging caps a local oxygen-viscosity switch's hydraulic gain
statement: For positive separable uptake with uniform resistance per extraction coordinate and nonnegative monotone oxygen-viscosity law,1<=dlog(p/kappa)/dlog(q)<=2; equal-demand branch disparity cannot shrink below its square root. Fixed-pressure uniform-low viscosity dominates.

requires: Fixed extraction-bed geometry, q>0, positive uptake f(c), defined exposure coordinate and nonnegative viscosity with positive averaged resistance.
provides: For positive separable uptake with uniform resistance per extraction coordinate and nonnegative monotone oxygen-viscosity law,1<=dlog(p/kappa)/dlog(q)<=2; equal-demand branch disparity cannot shrink below its square root. Fixed-pressure uniform-low viscosity dominates.
assumptions: The lower gain bound needs viscosity nondecreasing with oxygen. Nonuniform resistance profiles use the different1+sup(a*h/H)bound. No patency change, new oxygen source or real-tissue validation is supplied.
costs: For direct transmission, V>=4*F*A_y/(G*epsilon_max^2) and oxygen charge>=B_max*Delta_s*V. Finite oxygen stores appear in work bounds. Static pressure-area mismatch, friction, membranes, gross clock work and sensor charging remain inclusive. The selected synthetic candidate buys its18/24 threshold count at about2.02times hydraulic power; informed ordinary valves support19/24 under the original power budget versus the candidate's12/24 continuous final-window count. Objectives differ and no practical advantage follows. Delay-sensitive regimes can lose continuous adequacy despite acceptable averages.
contract.units: q is volume/time, pressure p is force/area, hydraulic work is energy; tau is time and omega is inverse time. G is modulus, V is volume, F*A_y is energy, epsilon is dimensionless strain, B_max is bound oxygen amount/volume. Tissue uptake and synthetic thresholds are supplied model quantities.
contract.obstruction: Acquire an oxygen-to-stroke unit with threshold, ligand kinetics, load/force balance, total work, inventory and cyclic drift measured separately. Preserve source-reported benchmark/correction/delay failures; do not promote the mathematical oxygen threshold into a biological viability criterion or claim replay of absent physical data.

body: Use z(c)=integral_c^ca ds/f(s), so z=(M/q)x. Setting g(z)=mu(c(z)) gives p/kappa=(q^2/M)*integral_0^(M/q)g. Log differentiation gives E=2-g(e)/A(e). Monotonicity makes0<=g(e)<=A(e), proving the bound. Integrate inverse slope between equal-demand branches for square-root residual disparity. Separately mu>=mu_lo implies p>=kappa*mu_lo*q at fixed pressure. These are local constitutive obstructions, not a prohibition of acquired localized actuation/recruitment.
